complexDefinition.stringValue: To shout or say in a loud voice.

text.stringValue: Говорить громко.
**Call** out before you start the machinery!
He decided to **call** for help.
She would often **call** my name from the garden.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To contact or communicate with someone, typically by telephone.

text.stringValue: Общаться по телефону.
**Call** your parents once you reach safely.
I will **call** you tomorrow.
Remember to **call** the pizza delivery service.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To name or refer to.

definition.stringValue: To give a name to something.

text.stringValue: Дать название чему-то.
They **call** him the king of pop music.
She **call**ed the kitten Snowball.
Can we **call** this meeting to order?

complexDefinition.stringValue: To command or summon.

definition.stringValue: To command or ask someone to come.

text.stringValue: Приказывать или просить кого-то прийти.
**Call** your brother back to the dinner table.
The coach **called** me to join the team practice.
She might **call** you into her office tomorrow.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To predict or forecast something.

text.stringValue: Предсказать что-то.
**Call** the stock market's rise and fall accurately.
He can **call** the election results before they're announced.
She **call**ed the outcome of the game in our favor.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To describe or classify something in a particular way.

definition.stringValue: To describe something in a certain way.

text.stringValue: Описывать что-то определенным образом.
They **call** him a hero for saving the child.
We **call** this strategy a success.
The scientists **call** it an important discovery.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To pay a short visit.

text.stringValue: Совершить кратковременный визит.
I'll **call** at your house later.
Let's **call** on Grandma after lunch.
He decided to **call** on his old teacher.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To require or demand.

text.stringValue: Требовать или нуждаться в чем-то.
The situation **calls** for immediate action.
His illness **calls** for extended bed rest.
The recipe **calls** for two cups of sugar.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To substitute a player from a game.

definition.stringValue: To replace a player in a game.

text.stringValue: Заменить игрока в игре.
**Call** Johnson off the field, we need a fresh striker.
The coach decided to **call** Smith to replace the injured goalkeeper.
It's time to **call** Thompson, our star pitcher is exhausted.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To decide the result or outcome.

text.stringValue: Определить исход.
**Call** the coin toss.
The umpire will **call** the baseball game.
He will **call** the election results.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To appeal for the doing or giving of.

text.stringValue: Запрашивать или умолять.
**Call** the police if you see suspicious activity.
I **call** upon you to aid in our town's recovery.
My friend **call**ed for help when her computer wouldn't start.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To stop at a place on a journey.

definition.stringValue: To make a stop during a journey.

text.stringValue: Сделать остановку во время путешествия.
**Call** at the station to pick up additional passengers.
They decided to **call** at a nearby cafe for lunch.
We should **call** at Grandma's house on our way home.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To awaken or rouse from sleep.

definition.stringValue: To wake up someone from sleep.

text.stringValue: Разбудить кого-то ото сна.
I **call** him every morning to wake him up.
She will **call** her sister to make sure she's awake.
Can you **call** me at 7 AM to ensure I'm up?

complexDefinition.stringValue: To order or organise the convening of a meeting or assembly.

definition.stringValue: To organize a meeting or assembly.

text.stringValue: Организовать встречу или собрание.
**Call** a board meeting to discuss company policy changes.
I'll **call** a family reunion to connect with distant relatives.
The teacher decided to **call** a parent-teacher conference.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To attract the attention of a person.

text.stringValue: Привлечь чьё-то внимание.
**Call** me when dinner is ready.
She **called** the waiter for the bill.
Can you **call** John for the meeting?

complexDefinition.stringValue: To invoke a divine presence.

text.stringValue: Вызывать божественное присутствие.
The priest **called** upon God for assistance.
Ancient civilizations would often **call** the spirits for guidance.
During the ceremony, the shaman **called** on ancestral spirits.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To use a particular title or term, in speaking or writing, when addressing or referring to a person or thing.

definition.stringValue: To address someone in a particular way.

text.stringValue: Обращаться к кому-то определенным образом.
**Call** me when you reach home.
I will **call** him John as his mother suggested.
Let's **call** her a genius.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To stop at a place to take on or put down passengers or goods.

definition.stringValue: To transport passengers or goods to a location.

text.stringValue: Перевозить пассажиров или товары в определенное место.
**Call** a taxi to the airport.
The company will **call** a courier to deliver your package.
Can you please **call** an Uber for me?

complexDefinition.stringValue: To establish a connection by telephone.

text.stringValue: Установить телефонное соединение.
**Call** your sister and ask about her day.
Remember to **call** the doctor for your check-up.
Before getting late, **call** the cab.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A loud shout or cry.

text.stringValue: Громкий крик.
**Call** from a mountain top echoed all around.
Bird's rhythmic **call** filled the early morning silence.
Rooster's wake-up **call** erupted on the farm at dawn.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A telephone communication or conversation.

text.stringValue: Телефонный разговор.
**Call** me after you've finished your work.
We'll discuss the plans during our next **call**.
She missed an important **call** from her boss.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A decision or judgement.

text.stringValue: Решение или суждение.
**Call** on the winner was a difficult task for judges.
The referee made a controversial **call** during the match.
After deliberating, her final **call** was to start up a bakery.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A short visit, typically one made in the course of duty or work.

definition.stringValue: A short visit for work or duty.

text.stringValue: Краткое посещение по работе или обязанностям.
**Call** to the CEO's office was unexpected.
She made a quick **call** at the local bakery.
The doctor had an emergency **call** at the hospital.

complexDefinition.stringValue: An instance of consultation.

text.stringValue: Обсуждение или консультационная встреча.
**Call** with the manager sorted out project issues.
Stressful **call** with the doctor about test results.
Late night **call** with the overseas client sealed the deal.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A brief social visit.

text.stringValue: Короткий социальный визит.
**Call** on an old friend during summer holidays.
Decided to make a relaxing **call** after a tiring day.
Enjoyed a pleasant afternoon tea **call** at Sally's house.

complexDefinition.stringValue: The act of calling in a subsitute player in a game.

definition.stringValue: The act of replacing a player in a game.

text.stringValue: Действие замены игрока в игре.
**Call** for the substitution left the team strategically better.
His injury prompted an urgent **call** in the basketball match.
Late-game **call** proved decisive, swapping striker for a midfielder.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A demand or claim.

text.stringValue: Требование или запрос.
**Call** of duty demanded his immediate return home.
The **call** for justice cannot be ignored any longer.
His work involves responding to the **call** of his people.

complexDefinition.stringValue: An appeal or demand for action.

text.stringValue: Требование действия.
**Call** for justice is often heard after incidents of injustice.
Her speech was a **call** to world peace and unity.
The protestors' **call** for action was largely ignored by authorities.

complexDefinition.stringValue: The characteristic cry of a bird or other animal.

definition.stringValue: The cry of an animal or bird.

text.stringValue: Крик животного или птицы.
**Call** of the loon echoed across the lake.
The rooster’s **call** woke me up early in the morning.
His favorite sound was the **call** of the meadowlark.

complexDefinition.stringValue: The vocation or strong inner prompting to a particular way of life.

definition.stringValue: An inner desire to follow a certain life path.

text.stringValue: Внутреннее желание следовать определенному жизненному пути.
**Call** has always guided him towards medical profession.
Her artistic **call** was too strong to ignore.
Ignoring his **call** towards social work seemed impossible.

complexDefinition.stringValue: An instance of speaking to someone on the telephone.

definition.stringValue: To talk to someone on a phone.

text.stringValue: Говорить с кем-то по телефону.
**Call** your mother, it's her birthday tomorrow.
She didn't answer my **call**.
I was waiting for his **call** all day.
